name: Chieftain Caimheul

facts.text: Level 65, 30,000 health, a realm-raid final. He fights with sword and shield and a two-handed weapon and changes according to where his foe stands.
From the front he slams with the shield to stun; against someone at his side he takes his two-hander (thrust, strength 400, parry); against a stun-immune foe he taunts and slashes.
At 50% health he enters a second phase and keeps the strength of 400.
'Caimheul' may echo Gaelic Caimbeul, 'crooked mouth'; to verify.

story: Caimheul ruled the Breifine hills before anyone built a keep on them, and he was famous for one thing: he was never in the wrong stance. Face him and he met you shield-first, and the shield came at your head. Slip to his side and the long spear was already turning. He was buried with all of it. The keeners sang him back up, and he came back exactly as he was, the crooked mouth set in the same half-smile, reading his enemies' feet as he always had. Once he is badly hurt he stops bothering with the shield. The old songs say he only ever did that twice in life, and both times the other side ran.
legend: Where you stand decides how he hits. In front he shield-slams and stuns; at his side he swaps to the two-hander and hits much harder. Main tank holds the front, everyone else stays behind him, not beside. After half health he keeps the big weapon out: heal the tank hard.

aggro: Who stands in my hall? Show me your feet.

phases.text: Put the shield down. This needs both hands.

death: Sing me... the right way... this time...
slay: You stood in the wrong place.

lairEntry: Three weapons hang ready. Their owner stands.
atmosphere.realmFirstKill: Chieftain Caimheul is sung on at last.

loremasterTopic.text: The old chieftain of the Breifine hills, sung back from his grave. He meets the front with his shield and the flank with his two-hander. Stand where he does not want you.

bookPage: They say Caimheul taught his sons with a stick in the yard: stand there, and I do this; stand there, and I do that. Every man in his war-band knew that where you put your feet decided how you died. The keeners sang him back with that lesson in him. The raid leaders of Hibernia teach it now the same way, with a stick in the dust outside Breifine. Behind him, they say. Never beside.
